finalText:
**14 user-visible changes out of 380 commits.** Draft is in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).

The rest is 100+ dep bumps, refactors, tests, and CI. None of it ships.

Three items I flagged as breaking are judgment calls:

| Change | Why breaking |
|---|---|
| `stop re-exporting the internal error types` | 8 commits, 5 modules. Imports break. |
| `drop the unused v1 export route` | Called unused. Verify no one hits it. |
| `return 401 for an expired token instead of 403` | Callers may branch on 403. |

Two things to check. Six `ci: run the suite on node 22` commits touch only CI and docs, so I left the min node version out. And four `perf` commits are real but have no heading in your shape.
